name: - A39 Tortoise
blurb: A British late-war heavy assault gun, designed partially as a counter to the German Jagdtiger Tank Destroyer.

name: - T32E1
blurb: The T32 / T32E1 was a proposed upgrade to the M26 Pershing, whose armor was thought to be too weak to fight against German Tigers.

name: - T58 Heavy Tank
blurb: The T58 Heavy Tank was an attempt to mount a 152mm (6") gun into a massive oscillating turret. The only prototype wasn't ordered.

name: - Object 279
blurb: The Object 279, armed with a fearsome 130mm cannon, was designed to resist the shockwave of a nuclear explosion. It was never mass produced.

name: - FV4005
blurb: The FV4005 is the largest gun ever fitted to a designated tank, at 183mm caliber. It had enough power to rip apart the IS-3's upper glacis.

name: - Sd Kfz 234/4
blurb: The Sd Kfz 234/4 was a lightly armored German WWII car armed with the powerful 75mm Pak 40 anti-tank gun.

name: - Leopard 2K
blurb: The Leopard 2K was a prototype for the Leopard 2, and was a very fast, capable, and dangerous MBT, armed with a 120mm Rheinmetall cannon.

name: - Begleitpanzer 57
blurb: The Begleitpanzer 57 was a German attempt to make their Marder IFV more capable, arming it with a TOW ATGM launcher and a 57mm autocannon.

name: - Ferdinand
blurb: The Ferdinand (or Elefant) was a heavy tank destroyer developed from the failed Porsche Tiger design, mounting the "long '88".

name: - IS-7
blurb: The IS-7 is perhaps the best heavy tank ever built, designed by the USSR after WWII. However, it was rendered obsolete by modern MBT's.

name: - CV90105 XC-8
blurb: The CV90105 XC-8 was a light tank, made from the Swedish CV90 IFV which mounted the Cockerill XC-8 turret and 105mm gun.
